canonicalPolicy.optionalTextSemantics: Optional text is represented as NULL; empty-string defaults are forbidden for cross-vendor consistency.
canonicalPolicy.blankStringPolicy: blank business values are normalized by application contracts; DDL does not use empty-string defaults
canonicalPolicy.batchPublishedDefinitionRuntime: bat_job, bat_schedule and bat_execution persist immutable definition_version/checksum
canonicalPolicy.batchExecutionAttemptLedger: Every worker attempt preserves definition version/checksum, fencing token and terminal or retryable outcome.
canonicalPolicy.batchDefinitionAudit: Fail-closed audit with verified requester/approver, approval request, transaction/trace and before/after snapshots.

batchJobIdentityPolicy.rule: all FK participating job_id columns use the same canonical width

canonicalPolicy.gatewayIngressTargetPathPolicy: Ingress path_pattern and target_path are separate; wildcard suffix is validated and rewritten before dispatch.
canonicalPolicy.batchExecutionAttemptDetailPolicy: Shell/external attempt detail including exit/stdout/stderr/truncation/duration/artifactHash/unknown is durable and transactionally finalized.
